aggregation.daily_fields: first open, maximum high, minimum low, last close, sum volume and amount
aggregation.daily_trade_time: last observed source trade_time across all symbols for that date; shared grid timestamp
aggregation.gap_policy: preserve all source minutes; no filling or calendar-based missing-minute inference
aggregation.invalid_row_policy: A row with any missing/non-finite/non-positive/inconsistent OHLC or missing/non-finite/negative vol/amount increments missing_or_invalid_count. Any invalid OHLC makes all daily OHLC fields null; invalid vol or amount makes that daily metric null. invalid_day is true.
aggregation.missing_or_invalid_count_scope: counts source rows with one or more invalid required numeric values; absent exchange minutes cannot be inferred without an external trading calendar
aggregation.timezone_assumption: Asia/Shanghai; naive source trade_time is local time

output.format: one UTF-8 CSV per symbol; no combined daily table
